title: Darth Sidious
subtitle: Under a Cloak of Darkness
text:
Hidden
Each other friendly Separatist unit gets +1/+0.
When a non-token unit is defeated: Create a Battle Droid token.
rules:
If Darth Sidious is defeated simultaneously with other units, his “When a non-token unit is defeated” ability trigger for each unit defeated, including himself.
If a unit has Hidden and Sentinel at the same time, it can be attacked.
